_doc: Polymaker PolyLite ASA, printed, for analysis: a second maker's figures beside asa (Bambu Lab ASA), so a design can be checked against either or see the spread between makers. Stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z); low and high are the sheet's own spread either side.
name: asa-polylite

modulus.source: Polymaker PolyLite ASA technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040), https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0548/7299/7945/files/PolyLite_ASA_TDS_EN_V5.4.pdf

modulus_z.source: Polymaker PolyLite ASA technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength.source: Polymaker PolyLite ASA technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength_z.source: Polymaker PolyLite ASA technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio (Polymaker publish none): an estimate for a printed amorphous plastic, as the kit takes PLA's (0.36) and PETG's (0.38)
poisson.source: An estimate of @rulecad/rules: no maker's data sheet gives one

density.source: Polymaker PolyLite ASA technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 1183, GB/T 1033)

softening.rule: Heat deflection temperature, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa: where a part under a little load starts to creep
softening.source: Polymaker PolyLite ASA technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 75)
